page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md file or a .zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.subtitle: Reusable review instructions. Link them to agents on each agent's Skills tab.

detail.previewSubtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported from a file. Its text is someone else's instructions inside your agents' prompts — keep it only if you have read it and trust it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be unlinked from every agent.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: Write as a directive — what this skill instructs the agent to do, and when.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when a PR changes tests. Flag branches and edge cases the tests don't cover.
form.versionHint: Saving a changed body creates a new version (v{version}).
form.required: Name, description and body are required.
form.bodyHint: Appended to the system prompt of every agent that enables this skill. Text only — never executed.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: From a Markdown file or a .zip with SKILL.md. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.pickHint: Read on the server, in memory. Only the Markdown skill file is used; scripts and other files are listed and never run.
import.trustTitle: You are importing someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once enabled for an agent, this text becomes part of that agent's prompt. Read it before saving. Scripts and other executable files are never run.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save of a changed body is a snapshot, so runs and evals stay reproducible against the exact text.
versions.diffLabel: Diff of v{version} against the current body

stats.noAgents: No agent links this skill yet. Link it on an agent's Skills tab.
